description.value:
Capstone, part two

A passive aura, independent of form, size, or whether you are shaped at all. It trails you permanently at a 60-foot radius. Ground you spend a full day inside becomes Reclaimed — irradiated, salted, and fouled earth cleaned, one day at a time, for the rest of your life.

You cannot turn it off. Over a campaign this redraws the map behind the party, and the places a Seed-Warden lingered become the places people can live. That is the whole point of the class arriving somewhere.
